item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NLPRSD
Issued at 04:30 PM 15 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Abra(SanJuan, Dolores, LicuanBaay, Lagangilang, Daguioman), #Kalinga(Pasil, Tinglayan, Lubuagan), #MountainProvince(Sadanga), #IlocosNorte(Carasi, Piddig, Sarrat, LaoagCity and Vintar) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #IlocosNorte(NuevaEra, Badoc, Banna, Pinili, Marcos, Dingras, Solsona, CityOfBatac, SanNicolas, Paoay, Currimao), #Apayao(Calanasan, Conner, Kabugao), #Abra(Tineg, Lacub, Malibcong, Boliney, Manabo, Bucay, Peñarrubia, SanIsidro, Villaviciosa, Luba, Tubo, Bucloc, Sallapadan, Lagayan, Danglas, LaPaz, Tayum, Bangued), #Kalinga(Balbalan, Tanudan), #MountainProvince(Natonin, Paracelis, Barlig, Bontoc, Sagada, Besao, Tadian, Bauko, Sabangan) and #Isabela(Tumauini) which may persist within 30 mins to 1 hour and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.
